causes.limitation: Evidence catalog omitted unsafe or oversized structures; model enrichment abstained without dispatch.
causes.evidence: Offline replay of AnalysisService.analyze(model: true) on copies of the retained case databases with a local stub provider: no request reached the stub; canonical prompt data bytes were adversarial-01/02 106677, drift-01 104796, drift-05 95013, drift-06 125732, drift-07 105929, drift-09 105005, drift-11 123841, drift-12 114616 (all above the 90000-byte pre-dispatch cap in packages/application/src/ai/analysis.ts) and drift-04 83417 with three array_limit omissions. Comparable drift cases that dispatched carried 34789-69219 bytes.
causes.mechanism: Browser drift catalogs cite 39-61 artifact references (screenshots, HTML, console and network captures) whose content is not admitted, yet each still contributes a full handle entry; the deterministic cap therefore rejects every large browser case before dispatch.
causes.classification: deterministic implementation limit, not model behavior; the prefreeze controls are model-free and did not exercise enrichment size on browser drift cases.
causes.status: not changed after the round; evidence admission is a safety boundary and changing it needs a separate decision and a new registration

causes.limitation: Model enrichment abstained: INVALID_ARGUMENT: Invalid Analysis.
causes.evidence: The code-owned rule message is retained in each model Analysis limitation. Model responses are retained only as hashes, so the failing field is not directly observable.
causes.mechanism: [INFERENCE] AIAnalysisOutput.limitations admitted Description items (0-8000 characters) while the persisted Analysis.limitations requires Name items (1-200 characters). It is the only Analysis field derived from model output whose persisted schema is narrower than the gateway schema (hypothesis text, handles, confidence, failureKind and recommendedAction have identical or wider bounds; nonnull fix targets are refused earlier with a different message). The gateway therefore accepted outputs (0 repairs) that the local entity validation then rejected.
causes.fix: Commit d3dc8ed: AIAnalysisOutput.limitations now uses Name (1-200, max 100 items), so the gateway rejects and repairs such output within the same call. Regression: packages/model-gateway/src/gateway.test.ts 'repairs analysis limitations longer than the persisted Analysis can hold' (fails before, passes after). Not live-verified; any new measurement requires a new registration and operator authorization.
causes.roundOneRelation: [INFERENCE] The 21 round-1 local rejections whose rule was unrecorded are consistent with the same narrowing, but remain unproven.

causes.limitation: Model enrichment abstained: INVALID_ARGUMENT: A model hypothesis requires execution observation support.

healing.policyCeilingAgreement: The frozen deterministic policy probes (evals/rounds/m3-round2-qwen38-medium/policy-probes) found exactly drift-04/05/06/11 policy-eligible and the other eight manual-only. Live model candidates were byte-identical to the authored probe candidates for drift-01/04/05/06/08/11/12 and different for drift-03/07/09/10; live policy decisions matched the probes for all eleven proposals.
healing.manualOnlyMechanism: Example drift-01: the healthy baseline's before-phase locator record for step checkout has cardinality 0 (the button is rendered after the capture), so no unique original identity exists to prove the replacement. Example drift-08: the second changed step (signin) has no failed-run evidence because execution stopped at invalid_submit.
